### Berserk State
Whenever the giant receives a certain amount of damage, it will become violent. While increasing its attack speed, it will also exposes its weakness and receive more damage.

### Home Advantage
The ancient monster fights on his home court, his own damage increases over time, and real damage received is reduced

### Lava Armor
The lava armor of Cerberus will reflect 100%/150%/200% of the damage received.

### Magma Ball
Cerberus spit out a magma ball, causing 700/900/1200 damage to the enemy

### Soul Release
The Cerberus screams to release the soul impact, causing 1000/1500/2000 damage

### Magma Shock
Hellhound tread on the ground in front of him, releasing underground magma, causing 2000/3500/5000 damage to the enemy
